Owner: Wing Wah Exploration and Production Petroliere; Societe Nationale des Petroles du Congo (SNPC)
Operator: Wing Wah Exploration and Production Petroliere
Location: Banga-Kayo field, Tchamba Nzassi sub-prefecture (near Pointe-Noire)
ResearcherNotesProject: AI-draft (discovery sweep; re-sourced off-GEM): Onshore associated-gas valorisation plant on the Banga-Kayo oil field, operated by Wing Wah E&P (Southernpec group, China) with national oil company SNPC; inaugurated 20 Nov 2025 by the Congolese president. Built in 3-4 phases (trains: T1 1 mcm/d online 2024, T2 2 mcm/d ~Mar 2025, T3 2 mcm/d ~Dec 2025; total 5 mcm/d ~1.8 bcm/y of associated gas processed). The plant produces dry gas, propane (~219,000 t/y), butane (~151,000 t/y), condensate (~88,000 t/y) AND LNG for domestic and international (regional) markets. Capacity 0.25 mtpa is an approximate LNG-only figure derived from press reporting of ~250,000 t/y LNG-and-dry-gas (Energy Capital & Power, New Congo LNG Volumes); the LNG-specific share is uncertain and needs confirmation before staging a firm number (yellow, single-source for the tonnage). This is a multi-product gas plant; only the LNG-export/liquefaction component is in scope for the LNG terminals tracker. GEM already has an upstream 'Banga Kayo (Phase 1) Oil and Gas Field' wiki page (the field, not this LNG plant) -- link via AssociatedTerminals on review. SNPC is Congo's national oil company and likely already exists as a GEM entity under another spelling -- resolve before adding a new entity. Coordinates not published; Tchamba Nzassi is the coastal sub-prefecture near Pointe-Noire, so site is near the existing Eni Congo FLNG terminals.
